messages:
Olivia: Quick heads-up — planning a short migration tonight: 'add_user_flags' on users table. Target window 01:00 UTC (2m exclusive lock). Plan:

Olivia: 1) Add nullable column user_flags_v2 + populate via async backfill
Olivia: 2) Switch read/write to user_flags_v2 in app (pin web svc)
Olivia: 3) Run final small backfill to fill remaining rows (<5k)
Olivia: 4) Drop legacy column next week after monitoring

Olivia: Migration command (run on deploy box):
```
PGPASSWORD=$PG_PASS ./manage_db migrate add_user_flags --ci --lock-timeout=120000
```

Olivia: Important operational notes:
- This needs an exclusive short table-level LOCK on users.user_flags column. Expect 90–150s worst-case if long-running transactions are present.
- Please pin the web service to v3.14.2 for the 30m surrounding the switchover to avoid code paths that write old column.
- Pause the async workers that write to users table (jobs/users_writer) for +10m around the switchover.
- We'll have a canary rollout: route 5% traffic to instances with the v3.14.2 toggle off before cutover.

deploy-bot: Scheduled migration job #2387 submitted by olivia for 2024-10-02 01:00:00 UTC. CI checks passed.

Sam: @olivia can you paste the quick query to estimate in-flight txs? want to watch for long transactions.

Olivia: Sure — run this on primary:
```
SELECT pid, state, now() - xact_start AS running, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname = 'redwood_prod' AND xact_start IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY running DESC LIMIT 10;
```

Mike: oncall-sre: ack. I'll be watching PG locks and tailing replica lag. I'll also set lock_timeout=120000 for the migration session.

Rachel: I'll prepare the release notes blurb and add the pin to the Helm chart: imageTag: v3.14.2 and annotate chart with migration flag.

oncall-sre: FYI I'll disable autoscaler for the web pool during the window to avoid rapid instance churn.

Sam: Also recommend adding this safety gate snippet to the migration wrapper to abort if replica lag > 30s:
```
if [[ $(psql -c "select now() - pg_last_xact_replay_timestamp()" -t) > '00:00:30' ]]; then
  echo "Replica lag high, aborting"; exit 1; fi
```

Olivia: Thanks all. If no objections I'll kick at 01:00 UTC. We'll have roll-back plan: restore app pin to v3.14.1 and run revert migration which only renames columns back (safe). :white_check_mark:

Sam: ack from my side. I'll run the pre-check 15m prior.

deploy-bot: Job #2387 started by olivia at 2024-10-02 01:00:12 UTC — status: running

Mike: migration complete. short lock ~42s. final backfill 4.2k rows. monitoring looks green.

Olivia: Great — unpinning web service after 45m and re-enable workers. Thanks team! :tada:
